title: Clean Water Bodies and Single-Use Plastic Prohibition Bill — Democratic Impact and Implementation Monitor
objective: Measure water-body protection, waste-system capacity, equitable transition and rights-respecting enforcement without creating a surveillance system.

affected_groups.group: Communities using surface and groundwater, including rural, coastal, tribal and low-income communities
affected_groups.baseline_source: Pre-enactment State/UT water-body, service and complaint inventory; methodology must be published.

affected_groups.group: Waste pickers, sanitation workers, small producers, traders and local bodies
affected_groups.baseline_source: Independent transition and labour assessment before each phase.

affected_groups.group: Persons with disabilities, health needs and emergency-service users

indicators.name: Verified water-quality and contamination trend
indicators.definition: Change in validated monitoring results and confirmed contamination events by receptor and community.
indicators.publication: Open, de-identified dashboard with uncertainty and method notes
indicators.independent_validation: Biennial external audit and random split-sample review
indicators.privacy_safeguard: No household or complainant identifiers published.

indicators.name: Safe collection and treatment capacity
indicators.definition: Whether sewage, septage, biological, religious and industrial waste services meet published capacity and access standards.
indicators.data_source: Local implementation plans, contracts and field audit
indicators.privacy_safeguard: Publish aggregate provider data only where required.

indicators.name: Enforcement equality and due process
indicators.definition: Inspection, notice, hearing, appeal, penalty and prosecution outcomes by sector and jurisdiction, tested for disparate or retaliatory patterns.
indicators.privacy_safeguard: No sensitive identity, political belief or protected activity data published.

indicators.name: Transition and accessibility outcome
indicators.definition: Timeliness and fairness of support, affordable alternatives and disability-accessible product availability.
indicators.publication: Aggregate results and reasons for material denials

oversight.body: CAG route or independent conflict-screened auditor, with legislative scrutiny
oversight.appointment_safeguard: Published selection criteria, conflict disclosures, fixed audit mandate and no audited authority selecting its own reviewer
oversight.audit_frequency: biennial, with annual public progress report
oversight.public_report: Published report laid before Parliament and relevant State/UT legislature
oversight.information_remedy: Reasoned refusal, independent review and court/legislative referral for unjustified withholding.

complaints.retaliation_protection: Confidential intake option, independent retaliation investigation and interim protection
complaints.outcome_publication: Anonymised quarterly timeliness and outcome statistics
complaints.appeal_route: Independent review plus statutory and constitutional court remedies.

triggers.condition: Repeated water-quality breach or missed treatment-capacity standard
triggers.responsible_body: Responsible public authority with auditor oversight
triggers.interim_protection: Immediate containment and alternative safe-service arrangement
triggers.correction: Funded remediation plan, public report and judicial referral if ignored

triggers.condition: Material disparate, retaliatory or politically selective enforcement pattern
triggers.responsible_body: Independent reviewer and court/tribunal where appropriate
triggers.interim_protection: Pause coercive action lacking objective grounds
triggers.correction: Case review, evidence disclosure, disciplinary referral and public aggregate report

triggers.condition: Transition support or accessible alternative is materially unavailable
triggers.interim_protection: Suspend affected phase for the group/area where necessary

review.legislative_review: annual report and five-year independent statutory review
review.sunset_or_review_date: Five years after commencement, then every five years
review.repeal_or_amendment_route: Published evidence review, public consultation and legislative amendment only.
